units: Y. Ber. IV, 8ᶜ top Moriah שמשם ה׳ וכ׳ because instruction goes forth &c.; Taan. 16ᵃ יצאה … היראה (not יצא); Gen. R. s. 55; Pesik. R. s. 40.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite>, a. e., v. preced.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:1:6">Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ</cite> top <he>איו הוֹרָאָתוֹ הורייה</he> bis decision is not binding.
<cite ref="Keritot 13b:63">Kerith. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>לא סגי ליה בלא ה׳</he> he could not help giving a practical decision (cases constantly coming before him).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 8:5:3">Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ואסור בה׳</he> and (he who drinks it) is forbidden to give a decision.
Hor. I, 1 ראוי לה׳ authorized to teach; a. v. fr.—(הוֹרָיַת) הוֹרָאַת שעה a decision under an emergency, a special dispensation (not to be taken as a precedent), opp. ה׳ לדורות.
Yoma 69ᵇ; a. fr.—מוֹרֶה ה׳ an authorized teacher, judge.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 4:6:5">Y. Naz. IV, end, 53ᶜ</cite> <he>עד שתורה ה׳ בישראל</he> before being appointed a teacher in Israel.
Hor. I, 5 (5ᵃ) הוריות ב״ד (Mish. ed. הוֹרָיַית); a. fr.—Horayoth (Horaoth), name of a treatise of Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli a. Y’rushalmi, on liability for erroneous decisions.
